candidates.author: Dr Grace France | uni tips
candidates.targetReplyText: How do you do this? sorry im old! 😂
candidates.observedSignals: 335 likes, 197 saves, 43 shares and 8 comments; the how-to question is unanswered
candidates.audienceFit: Students and knowledge workers asking how to organize research tabs
candidates.proposedReply: On desktop Chrome: right-click any tab → Add tab to group → New group, then name it. Drag other tabs into it; click the name to collapse it. Tip: name the outcome (‘essay draft’) rather than the topic (‘research’).
candidates.claimCheck: Chrome steps verified against current first-party Google Chrome Help: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/2391819?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en-uk. The naming tip is Blanc's workflow advice.
